text: I purchased the lifetime pro two years ago. Now I cannot restore the purchase in order to use the pro features.
author: Petros Ragias

text: At first I was thrilled by the idea of this app, it seemed to fit me perfectly. I paid for the pro subscription and I was shocked when I found out that I have to pay for every single new habit list. What's the "premium content" I'm unlocking with my subscription? I think it's a misleading description and the extra charges need to be clarified when someone is buying the pro version. It's unethical just to put the info in the little letters section, especially when you are a self improvement app.
author: Thomai Svarna
